summary_en.motivation: This study investigates whether same-day bilateral total hip arthroplasty increases the risk of deep infection compared to staged procedures.
summary_en.method: A retrospective cohort analysis was performed comparing infection rates between same-day and staged surgery groups.
summary_en.result: No significant increase in deep infection risk was found for same-day bilateral THA.
summary_en.validation: No biomechanical validation; only clinical statistical analysis.
